archetypes.name: dyn-gh-wrapper-seams
archetypes.rationale: Many call sites now share gh wrappers; verify argv order, repo optional forwarding, and failure artifacts.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect the converted production call sites and their tests for mismatches against gh.issue_view_field_read, issue_view_template_read, issue_edit_body_file, issue_close, and issue_label_add/remove. Confirm --repo is optional when absent, mutations are not locally retried, and stdout/stderr still land in the same preflight/bootstrap artifacts. Flag any remaining raw gh issue view/edit/close argv in the scoped modules. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
